name: Budget Coach Demo | Send And Log Reply

parameters.content:
# Budget Coach Demo | Send And Log Reply

Service (no AI). Called by "Budget Coach Demo | WF1 — Telegram Router & Check-ins" after an agent or Ask To Clarify answers, and by "Budget Coach Demo | WF2 — Scheduled Check-ins" after a scheduled agent call. Locked to those two callers.
Input: {chat_id, agent_name, chatInput, output} and, from "WF1", user_message_id (the Telegram number of the user's message). It formats the reply for Telegram, logs the original reply in the shared Agent Log (the row the Router reads for continuation and the check-ins read to skip), sends it, then saves the sent message's Telegram number on the same row (so a Telegram reply to it can be traced).
Standalone-capable: no. Errors: linked to "Error Handling | Main — Error Handler".

## Send And Log

Triggered by: Execute Workflow Trigger (a call from "WF1" or "WF2").

What it does, step by step:
1. Reformat For Telegram (Code, no AI): turns the reply into a Telegram card: agent header and date, emoji section titles, ▫️ bullets, and the cards the agent workflow built from Notion: `progress` (weekly goal → task → subtasks, by day) and `budget` (each budget line and the overall cap, bars 🟩 under 80%, 🟨 from 80%, 🟥 at 100%). Nothing on a card is shortened; a "[card: ...]" line is removed; a red 🔴 on error replies. The ➡️ hand-off line stays last. Too long for one message: split between whole lines into `telegram_rest`. The original reply stays in `output`.
2. Log Turn To Agent Log: stores the original reply and the user's message number (first, so "try again" works even if Telegram fails).
3. Send Telegram Reply: sends the card. If Telegram refuses it, Send Plain Telegram Reply sends the same text without formatting, so a reply is never lost.
4. Save Reply Message Id: adds the sent message's number to that row (a failure here only loses reply tracing).
5. More To Send? → Send Rest Of Reply: the second message, only when the reply did not fit in one.
